author: avibang
body:
Hey, welcome back! 

Not sure when you quit but I stopped playing around 2023 and just recently came back myself. Lots has changed, I went for the new area control on a whim and don’t think ive really noticed much of a difference. I think you need to switch over to get access to the Settlements? Someone else might be able to help more with that.

For gear/meta, I’d recommend just buying Beowulf for your T10. It’s really easy to make work with low gear investment since your pet does most of the heavy hitting. I know you mentioned not using Discord, but I’d really strongly suggest joining it just because that’s where the resources for Orna primarily live, and people who can answer questions round the clock. If you’re dead set on not using it, though, the best bang for your buck non event pets are gonna be the Chimera (with the Fey variant available currently as well), Fjalar, Fey Cactus, and the Mammon Acolyte. Each have their own strengths, so experiment with them and figure out which you like the most. If you happen to have an Arisen Spiritgarm already, though, it’s handedly the best pet for Beowulf at T10 early on. That thing absolutely shreds. 

The benefit of Beowulf early on is letting your pet clear out enemies for you while you bulk up your ward/defenses. I really hate to say it, but Realmshifter (which looks to be your class) is absolutely the hardest class to make work in T10 and beyond. Not bad, just harder. 

My recommendations are to run dungeons as often as you can to try to get better gear. Weekly/daily rewards also got reworked so now you spend a currency that you receive on a sort of “reward” tree, which can also include some nice gear. Once you feel comfortable, start trying to do the Towers of Olympia if you can find any. Towershards will be a big help down the line, and the achievements you get for reaching certain floors give you a massive Orns boost.

Hopefully this helps for some direction! Good luck out there!
